schema.reader: src/core/sources/eslcatalog.js: readEslCatalog(json).get(name) -> { values, errors, src, ref, refUrl, lim, est, priors, priorsFrom }
schema.units: days (times are JD as the catalogue gives them, normally BJD_TDB), depth as a fraction, Jupiter units for the planet, solar units for the star, a in au, angles in degrees, K in m/s, temperatures in K, distance in pc (src/core/sources/fields.js)

tables.snapshots: { nea, eu, ps }: date each source snapshot was taken
tables.sources: source ids; a planet's `c` is a bit mask over this list
tables.refs: [[label, link]]; link is an ADS bibcode (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/<link>/abstract), a full URL or ""
tables.prov: [[source index, ref index or -1]]: provenance of a value
tables.strs: interned strings: values of the string fields and notes of the estimates
tables.relations: [[key, name, citation]]: the relations of src/core/relations.js used for estimates
tables.estInfo: [[relation index, [field indices used], note index into strs or -1, chain 0|1 (built on another estimate)]]
tables.priorKeys: keys of suggestPriors (mplanet is the field `mass`)
tables.bases: how the priors were made: transit | rv | all = systemFromRows(rows, {use}) on every published reference of the NASA archive, centred on the chosen reference; merged = suggestPriors on the merged row (planets with no per-reference rows)

planet.a: names the other catalogues use, when different
planet.v: [[prov, field, value, error, field, value, error, ...], ...] catalogue values grouped by provenance; error 0 = none, number = symmetric, [lower, upper]; for an "s" field the value indexes strs
planet.l: [field, value, sign, source, ...] limits (not measurements; sign as the catalogue flags it)
planet.e: [field, value, estInfo, ...] gap-filled estimates; never a field that has a catalogue value
planet.p: [priorKey, a, b, priorWhy, ...]; uniform: a = min, b = max; normal: a = mean, b = std
planet.pb: [basis, ref index of the reference chosen for the priors or -1, ref index of the stellar reference or -1]

schema.rounding: periods, mid-transit times and their errors exactly as in the snapshots; other values 12 significant digits, errors 10; estimates and prior bounds 9 (priors on the period 15, on T_mid 16)
schema.oddities: neaNotInPs: planets of the composite table missing from the per-reference snapshot (priors then fall back to basis merged); chooseFailed: systemFromRows gave nothing for the planet (same fallback); emptyPriors: planets with no prior at all; nonFinitePriors / unusablePriors: priors suggestPriors returned that are not stored (not finite; uniform with min >= max or normal with zero width, from a catalogue value outside the physical range); duplicateNames: two rows with one name. Each: { n, first: up to 25 }
schema.notStored: the time-dependent `drift` column of buildTable, catalogue disagreements (`diff`), the match stage, and the text explaining why a reference was chosen: recompute those with the site code from the snapshots
